title: Leakage-Free Benchmarking of Classical Machine Learning and Graph Neural Networks for Low-Data TgDHFR Bioactivity Prediction: analysis pipeline
description:
Reproducible pipeline that audits the data leakage of a published TgDHFR QSAR study and benchmarks classical stacking ensembles against graph neural networks under a leakage-free nested cross-validation protocol, with an applicability-domain-aware virtual screening and a generalization cohort of MoleculeACE targets.

Every number the manuscript states is exported by the pipeline as a LaTeX macro, so the text cannot drift from the results; the repository documents which script produces each family of values and checks the manuscript against them.

The code is MIT licensed. The data under data/ are third-party and keep the terms of their sources (ChEMBL and BindingDB through the release of Karimova & Senanayake, a PubChem extract, the MoleculeACE benchmarks of van Tilborg et al., and PDB entry 6AOG); they are redistributed so that the pipeline runs as published, not relicensed.
